abstract: OBJECTIVE: To examine histologic findings and clinical outcomes of patients who underwent neck dissection for residual neck masses. METHODS: From 1987 to 2008, 968 postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RPLND) were performed at our institution. We identified 41 of these patients who underwent a postchemotherapy residual neck mass resection. RESULTS: Thirty-nine patients presented with primary testis, one with retroperitoneal, and one with mediastinal GCT. Teratoma was present in 54% of patients at diagnosis. During the neck dissection, 23 (56.1%) patients had teratoma, 14 (34.2%) had fibrosis, three (7.3%) had viable GCT, and one had benign lymph nodes. There was histologic discordance between the neck and the RPLND in 22.5% of patients and between the neck and other extraretroperitoneal resection sites in 26.5% of patients. At a median follow-up of 49.5 months from diagnosis, 16 patients had recurrence, and seven had died of testis cancer. No patient had recurrence in the neck. Five of seven patients with residual viable cancer at extraretroperitoneal resection sites died of disease compared with two of 23 with teratoma and none with fibrosis (P = .0005). CONCLUSIONS: Resection of residual postchemotherapy neck masses is indicated because of the high incidence of viable tumor or teratoma in the residual mass and the inability to accurately predict the histology of the neck masses. Resection of residual neck masses leads to excellent local control and can contribute to long-term disease control and survival.
abstract_ja: 目的：化学療法後の残存頸部腫瘤に対して頸部郭清術を受けた患者の組織学的所見と臨床転帰を検討する。方法：1987年から2008年にわれわれの施設で968例の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）が行われた。そのうち、化学療法後の残存頸部腫瘤切除を受けた41例を同定した。結果：39例が原発性精巣、1例が後腹膜、1例が縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍であった。診断時に奇形腫が認められた患者は54%であった。頸部郭清術では、23例（56.1%）に奇形腫、14例（34.2%）に線維化、3例（7.3%）に生存腫瘍、1例に良性リンパ節が認められた。頸部と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の間で組織学的不一致が22.5%、頸部と他の腹膜外切除部位との間で26.5%に認められた。診断からの追跡期間中央値49.5か月で、16例に再発が認められ、7例が精巣がんで死亡した。頸部の再発は認められなかった。腹膜外切除部位に残存生存腫瘍が認められた7例のうち5例が原病で死亡したのに対し、奇形腫の23例中2例が死亡、線維化の例では死亡はなかった（P = .0005）。結論：化学療法後の残存頸部腫瘤切除は、残存腫瘤に生存腫瘍または奇形腫が高頻度に含まれ、組織型を正確に予測できないため適応となる。残存頸部腫瘤の切除は良好な局所制御をもたらし、長期的な病勢制御と生存に寄与し得る。
